memo_delta.summary: The confirmed cash offer price and higher annual earnings guidance weaken parts of the original Avoid reasoning. Refused approval for the Taiwan sale removes an assumed near-term cash tailwind. The Spain warning remains subsidiary-specific; deal settlement and unadjusted full-year cash flow are unresolved, and existing integrity restrictions remain.
memo_delta.stage_one_comment: The original decision was Avoid, not a short or an entry instruction. Primary issuer releases now confirm the cash offer price and raise annual earnings guidance, weakening the old claim that the offer price was unconfirmed. The Taiwan sale has not received approval, so its expected cash proceeds must not be counted as received. The retrieved annual audit report still describes uncertainty at the Spanish subsidiary, with an unmodified group opinion. Because that report predates the original decision, its wording is not a newly successful forward forecast. Neither of the two short earnings tests cleared its original decisive threshold; both remain inconclusive. Deal settlement and unadjusted annual cash flow remain open. Keep watching the evidence while maintaining the existing no-entry restriction. This review changes no model or original record, does not clear the integrity flag, and supplies no benchmark-adjusted investment result.
